description: GEOMETRY — the sub-world of mathematics: the classical study of figures and space, giving the concept-graph descent a third rung below mathematics.

microtheory.name: geometry
microtheory.definition: The classical study of points, lines, angles and figures in the plane and space: Euclid's theorems, the Pythagorean relation, area and coordinate methods.

concepts.name: point
concepts.definition: A position with no extent — the primitive of geometry.

concepts.name: line
concepts.definition: A straight one-dimensional figure extended without end.

concepts.name: angle
concepts.definition: The figure formed by two rays sharing an endpoint, measuring rotation.

concepts.name: triangle
concepts.definition: A three-sided polygon, the simplest rectilinear figure.

concepts.name: circle
concepts.definition: The set of points equidistant from a centre.

concepts.name: polygon
concepts.definition: A closed plane figure bounded by straight segments.

concepts.name: area
concepts.definition: The measure of the two-dimensional extent of a figure.

concepts.name: coordinate
concepts.definition: A number locating a point relative to axes (Descartes' method).

concepts.name: euclidean_geometry
concepts.definition: Geometry from Euclid's five postulates — the geometry of flat space.

concepts.name: pythagorean_theorem
concepts.definition: In a right triangle the square on the hypotenuse equals the sum of the other two.
